title: In This City You Can Only Say One Word
description: Say any other word and you get switched off. Then a new kid walked down our street… talking.

scenes.narration: In this city, you're allowed to say exactly one word: *Huss*.
Good morning? Huss. I love you? Huss. Help? *Huss*. Two million people, one single word.
And if you say anything else, you get *switched off*.
Mister Brown said sorry once. Just once. He has been standing on the square ever since.
Hundreds of them. Grey. Frozen. Nobody knows if they can still hear us.
I've said Huss about eleven thousand times in my life. I have never said my own name.
Then one Monday, a new kid walked down our street. And he was *talking*.
Real words. Hello. Nice shoes. Where's the bakery? The whole street went silent.
We all waited for the zap. It never came. Finn just smiled and asked me my name.
That night, he told me a secret. The switching off was never a rule. It was a *story*. Told to scare us.
The next morning, he walked up to Mister Brown and said: you can stop now. And Mister Brown *blinked*.
He was never switched off. He was just too scared to move. For eleven years.
Every statue on that square is a person still waiting for someone to say: it's okay.
Tomorrow at noon, the whole city meets on the square. Finn wants me to say my name. Out loud. In front of everyone.
If he's wrong, I get switched off forever. If he's right, two million people get their words back. Should I say it? And what would *your* first word be?
